sentences.text: 1. The State is challenging the judgment of the Reference Court under Section 28A(3) of the Land Acquisition Act.
The land belonging to the respondent/claimant having an extent of 1.60 Ares was acquired as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 01.12.2004 for widening Ponkunnam- Thodupuzha road.

Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation, fixing the land value @ Rs.38,889/- per Are,
including the property in 'D' Category.
2.
The claimant filed an Application under Section 28(A) of the Land Acquisition Act claiming determination of the land value on the basis of the judgment in LAR No.91/2015.
The said judgment is produced before the Reference Court as Ext.A3.
On reference, the Reference Court fixed the land value at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are, relying on 2025:KER:72519 LA Appeal No.128 OF 2021 Ext.A3 judgment in LAR No.91/2015.
On perusing Ext.A3 judgment, I find that Ext.A3 property is included in the 'D' category, and the Land Acquisition Officer awarded the same land value at Rs.38,889/- per Are.
In such a case, the claimant is entitled to get the fixation of land value equal to the land value granted in the Ext.A3 judgment.
In Ext.A3 judgment, the land value is fixed at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are for the 'D' category.
The Reference Court rightly fixed the land value at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are, relying on Ext.A3 judgment.
I find no reason to interfere.

Sd/-

opennyai_summary.facts:
1. The State is challenging the judgment of the Reference Court under Section 28A(3) of the Land Acquisition Act.
The land belonging to the respondent/claimant having an extent of 1.60 Ares was acquired as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 01.12.2004 for widening Ponkunnam- Thodupuzha road.
Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation, fixing the land value @ Rs.38,889/- per Are,
including the property in 'D' Category.
2.
The claimant filed an Application under Section 28(A) of the Land Acquisition Act claiming determination of the land value on the basis of the judgment in LAR No.91/2015.
The Collector rejected the Application.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The said judgment is produced before the Reference Court as Ext.A3.
On reference, the Reference Court fixed the land value at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are, relying on 2025:KER:72519 LA Appeal No.128 OF 2021 Ext.A3 judgment in LAR No.91/2015.
In such a case, the claimant is entitled to get the fixation of land value equal to the land value granted in the Ext.A3 judgment.
In Ext.A3 judgment, the land value is fixed at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are for the 'D' category.
The Reference Court rightly fixed the land value at Rs.1,95,248/- per Are, relying on Ext.A3 judgment.
I find no reason to interfere.
3. Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed.
